verses.1: And the sons of Israel stood on high, in their camp. They took Akhen, son of Carmi, and Zabadai, son of Zerah, from among the camp, and they set them as leaders over the people of Judah. Thus, Jehovah honored the sons of Israel.
verses.2: And Joshua sent men from Jericho, which was near to Bethel. He said to them, “Go and take possession of the land.” So the men went and took possession of the land.
verses.3: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, “Let not all the people come up together; let only a few hundred men go up, so that they won’t overwhelm the whole population. Otherwise, they will surely succeed in their plan.”
verses.4: And three thousand men from the people came forward. They stood before the people of Ai.
verses.5: And they were attacked by those men with hands like claws. There were thirty-six or sixty of them. They chased them before the gates, all the way to the gates themselves. They attacked them from behind, and their hearts were filled with fear. It became like a sea of blood.
verses.6: And Joshua cut his clothes, and dirt fell on his face before the LORD’s altar until morning. Then the elders of Israel stood up and raised their hands.
verses.7: And Joshua said, “Ah, Lord Jehovah! Why have you brought this people across the Jordan River, so that they could fall into the hands of the Amorites, who will capture us and take us captive across the Jordan River.”
verses.8: My Lord, what did You say after Israel became a target of its enemies?
verses.9: And the Canaanites and all the people who live in this land will hear of us. They will turn against us and destroy our name from the earth. What will you do to your great name then?
verses.10: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Why do you fall before your face?”
verses.11: Israel committed sins. They also broke the covenant I had made with them. They took things that belonged to others, stole from others, and committed other evil deeds.
verses.12: And the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies. They would turn away from their enemies, because they were under a curse. They could not remain with you unless you removed that curse from them.
verses.13: May the people be sanctified. You said, “They shall be sanctified tomorrow.” For as Jehovah, the God of Israel, has said, “Israel will not be able to stand before their enemies until they are freed from their sin.”
verses.14: And in the morning, they shall go before their own altars. And the altar that Yahweh will bring down upon us will also bring down upon the families of those who are under His control. And the house that Yahweh will bring down upon us will also bring down upon the tribes of those who are under His control.
verses.15: And he who is caught up in sin will be destroyed by fire, along with everything he owns. For he has broken the covenant of Jehovah, and because he has committed evil deeds against Israel.
verses.16: In the morning, Joshua led Israel back into their land. He brought the Jews back under their rule.
verses.17: And he gathered together the family of Judah, and he also gathered together the family of Zerah. Then he brought those people together with the tribes. And he gathered Zabdi together with them.
verses.18: And he brought his house to the people of Gibeah. He gathered Akhen, son of Carmi, and Zabdi, son of Zerah, to the place where Yehuda lived.
verses.19: And Joshua said to Achan, “Son of Akhen, please honor the LORD, the God of Israel. Give him a name and tell him what he has done. Do not be more proud than I am.”
verses.20: And Achan said to Joshua, “I have sinned against Jehovah, the God of Israel. I have done these and those things.”
verses.21: And I saw in the pile of gold a fine young man. His weight was fifty shekels, and he had a golden tongue. I took him away with me. They were buried in the ground, inside the tent. And the gold was placed under him.
verses.22: And Joshua sent out the demons. They rushed into the tent, and there they were hidden within it. And the gold coins were also hidden there.
verses.23: They took them out of the tent and brought them before Joshua and all the children of Israel. They placed them before Jehovah.
verses.24: And Joshua took Akhen, son of Zerach, along with the money, the jewelry, and all the gold objects. He also took his sons and daughters, his livestock, and everything else that belonged to him. He took them all up onto the mountain of Akor.
verses.25: And Joshua said, “What have you done to us? The LORD has punished you today.” All of Israel was destroyed by stones and fire. They were scattered across the land.
verses.26: And they built a large stone wall over it, as it is to this day. And Jehovah sat on His throne from there. That place is called “Emek Akhor” to this day.
